title.narrative: In 2025, UNICEF Libya secured transformative systemic gains by validating justice-sector SOPs and finalizing MoD-endorsed CAAC protection guidelines. Despite operational constraints, UNICEF institutionalized specialized police curricula, initiated a national social work professionalization roadmap, and leveraged MICS data to culturally adapt a national positive parenting framework.
